tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search all pages and databases shared with the integration by title; filter by object type and sort by last edited time (POST /v1/search)

query.description: The text that the API compares page and database titles against.

filter.description: A set of criteria that limits results to either only pages or only databases: {"value": "page"|"database", "property": "object"}.

sort.description: Criteria to order results by; only last_edited_time is supported: {"direction": "ascending"|"descending", "timestamp": "last_edited_time"}.

start_cursor.description: A cursor value returned in a previous response; results start after the cursor. Defaults to the first page of results.

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list to include in the response. Maximum: 100.

tools.name: notion_page_get
tools.description: Retrieve a Notion page object using the ID specified (GET /v1/pages/{page_id})

tools.name: notion_page_create
tools.description: Create a new page as a child of an existing page (POST /v1/pages)

parent_id.description: The parent page where the new page is inserted (parent.page_id). Defaults to the workspace root when omitted.

title.description: The title of the page (properties.title, plain text).

tools.name: notion_page_update
tools.description: Update page property values or the archived status for the specified page (PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id})

title.description: New title for the page (properties.title, plain text). Only written when provided.

archived.description: Whether the page is archived (deleted). Set to true to archive a page, false to un-archive it.

tools.name: notion_page_archive
tools.description: Archive (move to trash) or restore a page by setting the archived flag (PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id})

page_id.description: Identifier for the Notion page to archive or restore.

archived.description: Set to true to archive (trash) the page; set to false to restore it.

tools.name: notion_databases_list
tools.description: List all databases shared with the integration (GET /v1/databases)

limit.description: The number of databases desired in the response (page_size). Default 30, maximum 100.

tools.name: notion_page_properties_get
tools.description: Retrieve the property values of a database page (row), or a single property item when property_id is given (GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id})

page_id.description: Identifier for the database page (row) whose properties you want.

property_id.description: Identifier (property name) for the specific property to retrieve. When omitted, all property values are returned.

tools.name: notion_database_get
tools.description: Retrieve a database object, including its property schema, for the provided ID (GET /v1/databases/{database_id})

tools.name: notion_database_create
tools.description: Create a database as a subpage in the specified parent page, with the defined property schema (POST /v1/databases)

parent_id.description: The parent page the database is created under (parent.page_id).

title.description: Title of the database as it appears in Notion (plain text).

description.description: Description of the database as it appears in Notion (plain text).

properties.description: JSON-encoded property schema of the database: an object mapping property names to their type definitions, e.g. {"Name": {"type": "title"}, "Risk": {"type": "select"}}.

tools.name: notion_database_query
tools.description: Query a database: get a list of the pages (rows) it contains, filtered and ordered by the property values in the request (POST /v1/databases/{database_id}/query)

database_id.description: Identifier for the Notion database to query.

filter.description: When supplied, limits which pages are returned based on the filter conditions: a leaf condition {"property": "Risk", "select": {"equals": "Yellow"}} (equals / does_not_equal / contains / does_not_contain), or a compound {"and": [...]} / {"or": [...]}.

sorts.description: When supplied, orders the results: an array of sort objects [{"property": "Renewal Date", "direction": "ascending"}] or [{"timestamp": "last_edited_time", "direction": "descending"}].

start_cursor.description: A cursor value returned in a previous response; results start after the cursor. Defaults to the first page of results.

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list to include in the response. Maximum: 100.

tools.name: notion_database_row_create
tools.description: Create a new page (row) in the specified database with the given property values (POST /v1/pages with parent.database_id)

database_id.description: The database this page belongs to (parent.database_id).

properties.description: JSON-encoded property values keyed by property name, matching the database schema, e.g. {"Name": "Atlas - FY2027 Renewal", "Risk": "Green", "ARR": 320000}.

tools.name: notion_database_row_update
tools.description: Update property values or the archived status of a database page (row) (PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id})

page_id.description: Identifier for the database page (row) to update.

properties.description: JSON-encoded property values to write, keyed by property name. Replaces the stored property values when provided.

archived.description: Whether the page is archived (deleted). Set to true to archive the row.

tools.name: notion_blocks_children_list
tools.description: Return a paginated array of child block objects contained in the block (page) specified (GET /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children)

block_id.description: Identifier for a block. Also accepts a page ID, returning the page's top-level blocks.

limit.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response (page_size). Default 30, maximum 100.

tools.name: notion_blocks_append
tools.description: Append new child blocks to the block (or page) specified; children are added to the bottom in order (PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children)

block_id.description: Identifier for a block. Also accepts a page ID; children are appended to that page.

children.description: Child content to append: an array of block objects, e.g. [{"type": "paragraph", "paragraph": {"rich_text": [{"text": {"content": "..."}}]}}]. A simplified form [{"type": "to_do", "text": "...", "checked": false}] is also accepted. Supported types: paragraph, heading_1, heading_2, heading_3, bulleted_list_item, numbered_list_item, to_do, quote, callout.

tools.name: notion_block_get
tools.description: Retrieve a block object using the ID specified (GET /v1/blocks/{block_id})

tools.name: notion_block_delete
tools.description: Set a block object to archived: true using the ID specified; the block is moved to trash (DELETE /v1/blocks/{block_id})

block_id.description: Identifier for the Notion block to delete.

tools.name: notion_comments_list
tools.description: Retrieve a list of un-resolved comment objects from the specified page or block (GET /v1/comments)

block_id.description: Identifier for the page or block whose comments you want to retrieve.

limit.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response (page_size). Default 30, maximum 100.

tools.name: notion_comment_create
tools.description: Create a comment in a page or existing discussion thread (POST /v1/comments)

parent_id.description: The page or block the comment is attached to (parent.page_id). Either parent_id or discussion_id must be provided.

discussion_id.description: The ID of an existing discussion thread to add the comment to.

rich_text.description: The comment text content (rich_text, flattened to plain text).

tools.name: notion_users_list
tools.description: Return a paginated list of users for the workspace (GET /v1/users)

limit.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response (page_size). Default 30, maximum 100.

tools.name: notion_user_get
tools.description: Retrieve a user object using the ID specified (GET /v1/users/{user_id})

user_id.description: Identifier for a Notion workspace user.
